name: Kallang Bahru
summary: Industrial-residential mid-town belt between Lavender and Geylang Bahru — practical condo/HDB edges with CTE adjacency and less tourist gloss than Bugis.
body: Kallang Bahru is the shortlist when mid-town practicality and quieter nights matter more than mall-spine living. The belt sits between Lavender / Bendemeer gravity and Geylang Bahru industrial-residential edges; housing mixes HDB slabs with selective condo pockets. Expats land here for manageable CBD hops and car-light errands without Orchard premiums. Watch-outs: industrial traffic peaks, older-block FOC culture, and last-mile variance. Compare with Bugis South for denser central energy, Bendemeer East for NEL-adjacent living, and Mattar when DTL doorstep wins.
watchOuts: Fewer café-strip amenities than Joo Chiat
Walk to MRT depends on block
housingMix: Mature HDB with selective condo / executive pockets.
commuteNotes: Nearest MRT gravity toward Lavender / Bendemeer / Geylang Bahru / Mattar depending on block. Time Tuesday 08:15 door-to-desk before you LOI.
